name: Ione

backstory.text: Ione lives in the north-west house and treats the chest there as private.
Ione speaks briefly and leaves a conversation that will not change the subject.
Ione already finds Bram loud and thinks he talks over people.

temperament: Prefers her own doorway to the square.
Notices when objects in her house move.

seed_relationships.note: Thinks Bram talks over people. Bram may not know she feels this way.
